verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a full REST API v1 for programmatic control of pods, endpoints, templates, volumes and registries, plus an S3-compatible API and CLI as alternate programmatic surfaces, with docs explicitly aimed at integrating into applications/automation. This is well-documented and corroborated by an API-reference overview page, though an OpenAPI/swagger spec could not be located via probe. Missing for 10: publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger schema, independent third-party developer accounts of API integration.
